records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Historically its second and third quarter financial results have reflected higher travel demand, and were better than its first and fourth quarter financial results.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the three months ended March 31, 2024 and 2023, the Company recognized approximately $4.0 billion and $3.5 billion, respectively, of passenger revenue for tickets that were included in Advance ticket sales at the beginning of those periods.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Republic currently operates 66 regional aircraft under capacity purchase agreements ("CPAs") that have terms through 2035.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the three months ended March 31, 2024, the Company incurred $13 million of charges primarily consisting of a settlement related to a certain pilot long term disability plan, accelerated depreciation on assets with shortened lives, and other losses on disposal of assets, which were partially offset by a gain from a favorable outcome related to a certain contract dispute as well as gains on sales of assets.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Passenger revenue increased $1.0 billion, or 10.1%, in the first quarter of 2024 as compared to the year-ago period, primarily due to a 9.1% increase in capacity and a 0.7% increase in Yield.
